record.question: Who is the US Special Representative on North Korea?
record.explanation: Answer D: Stephen Biegun. The archived State Department biography records Stephen Biegun’s appointment as Special Representative for North Korea on 23 August 2018. That is the appropriate incumbent for this April 2019 paper. Lee Do-hoon represented South Korea, not the United States. Historical/source note: Historical 2018–19 appointment; archived present-tense statements are not a claim about the office today. Reference: https://2017-2021.state.gov/biographies/stephen-biegun/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
